KG-MSPF: Hidden width 16, 2 heads, 1 relational layer, dropout 0.3, AdamW weight decay 0.01; Cox ties and training-fold preprocessing as implemented.
Clinical+PAM50-Cox: Cox on clinical variables plus observed PAM50 labels
FullConcat-Cox: Cox on shared fold-specific flattened multimodal inputs
FullConcat-LASSO-Cox: FISTA Cox LASSO, relative penalty path, independently preprocessed inner folds
RSF: scikit-survival RandomSurvivalForest; leaf-size choice on inner training/validation
SurvTRACE: SurvTRACE-style single-event Transformer reimplementation, not the authors' original implementation
Cox-PASNet: Cox-PASNet-style pathway-mask reimplementation, without the original sparse-coding step
HomoGAT: Relation-agnostic GAT baseline; its independent baseline schedule has minimum epoch 60.
molecular_graph_only: Additional diagnostic ablation; clinical node values masked, PAM50 removed, no clinical head or Cox blending
